title: The Human Before the World
author: Ethan James Farrell
description: A reflection on the primordial human: the idea of a human form or archetype preceding the created world. It opens a path into questions of origin, identity and humanity's place in sacred cosmology.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
